# Data

The application is a static review package. Its prototype text and media are bundled files; there is no server-side data service evidenced in this repository.

## Databases

No SQL or other database connection, schema project, query, or database object is present in the repository.

## Storage accounts

No Azure or other remote storage account, container, queue, table, file share, SAS, account key, or storage identity is configured.

The review does use browser `localStorage` (not a cloud storage account) for saved motion sets. The key is `claycoLeadership.motionSets.v1`; stored entries contain an ID, reviewer-provided name, and motion settings, and the interface retains up to 30 sets (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/review.js:31-33,252-254`). The review reads these entries at startup and writes them when a set is saved or deleted (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/review.js:32-33,109,252-254`).

The separate motion study uses `claycoMotionOptions.v3` for motion preferences and `claycoMotionSets.v1` for named sets (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/Clayco Home Motion Options.html:780-791,1177-1198`). The original and new Sam Alcarez prototype pages use `sessionStorage` key `clayco-intro-seen` to remember whether the intro played in the current session (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/designs/sam-alcarez-original/assets/home-intro.js:8,21-22,45`). None of these stores syncs data to a server.

## Snowflake

This repository does not connect to Snowflake. There is no Snowflake account, service account, Entra connector, query, view, or dynamic table to inventory.

## URL state

The review can encode design, motion family/mix, pause state, preview device, and selected section in the URL (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/review.js:42-48`). Sharing that URL shares those interface settings, not a server-side record.

Some static prototype pages load public images or videos from `e1.nmcdn.io` and `storage.ghost.io`; those are read-only media requests, not application data stores (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/Clayco Home Motion Options.html:659,697-704`, `animated/project-ljc.html:92`).
